note: baseline* is REPORT.md §4 (0.6.0); measured is the final tree. File tasks use FAKE_SSH_EXEC on local temp files.

tasks.task: check disk on 5 hosts (discover + fan out)
tasks.note: one list_connections (183 tok) + one run_on_many (224 tok). Calling run_command per host would cost 41 tok/host over 5 calls.

tasks.task: tail a log (agent asks for last 50 lines)
tasks.note: 50 log lines are 15,445 bytes, so the 8 KiB default keeps head+tail (2,818 tok); 20 lines fit under the cap (2,138 tok). Forgetting tail now costs the same 8 KiB (2,818 tok) instead of the old 64 KiB head (22,577 tok).

tasks.task: edit one line in a 20 KiB config
tasks.note: read_remote_file(1,10) + replace_in_remote_file + grep_remote verify = 284 tok. The old path cat the whole 5,537 tok file, re-emitted it, rewrote it non-atomically, then verified. New responses: read 166, replace 89, verify 29 tok.
One compound command works without sudo. With sudo the failure (87 tok) is classified as "tty" and the hint names tty:true / sudo -n.

tasks.task: find which of 10 hosts has an error
tasks.note: match: "[1-9]" returns only web04's matching line; the summary still says total=10, failed=0. The all-results reply costs 214 tok for the same answer.
read_remote_file(offset:200, limit:41) adds numbered lines and totalLines. The response is payload-bound; the gain is a discoverable schema, binary refusal, and no sed quoting, not fewer tokens.

tasks.task: recover from a typo in an alias
tasks.note: The error now carries errorKind, a hint, and 3 suggestions, so the retry is immediate: 34 + 29 tok. The old path was error + a full list_connections (2,710 tok at 10 connections).

tasks.task: fleet check (50 hosts, one line each)
tasks.note: only:"failures" returns the summary with no result rows (23 tok). All 50 results cost 974 tok.

sudoError.hint: sudo needs a terminal here. Retry with `tty: true`, or use `sudo -n` with passwordless sudo so an agent never waits on a prompt.
